title: Australian Politicians Were Already on Edge Before One of Their Own Was Attacked
summary_full: Much remains unclear about why a driver ran a car into Helen Haines, a lawmaker. Even so, fellow representatives, especially women, spoke of feeling threatened in a polarized atmosphere.
